name: icloud-busy-feed
description: Read-only Cloudflare Worker that turns iCloud CalDAV calendars into busy intervals for Apps Script
author: Alex Samson (https://saalse.com)

ICLOUD_APPLE_ID.description: Your Apple ID (the email you sign in to iCloud with).

ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD.description: An app-specific password made for this Worker only: [account.apple.com](https://account.apple.com) → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords. Not your Apple ID password.

FEED_TOKEN.description: The feed token that setupICloud created in your Apps Script project: Project Settings → Script Properties → ICLOUD_FEED_TOKEN. Paste it exactly.
